name: grade-it-like-an-audit
description: Audit-style grading and evaluation for high-stakes recurring work: guided setup, a blind per-unit auditor fan-out with a lead consistency pass, a bounded loop to convergence, calibration against your own grading, and a write-back loop that makes your instructions stronger every run.
